Golden Designs GDI-8260-01 6-person full spectrum infrared sauna combines Near Zero EMF PureTech™ FAR IR carbon panels, near IR elements, Himalayan salt bars, and Canadian Hemlock wood construction for a spacious indoor sauna experience. Built for larger home wellness spaces, this model offers a roomy 73″ W x 55″ D x 74″ H exterior footprint with seating capacity for up to 6 people, making it a practical fit for shared relaxation, family use, or a dedicated home recovery area.

The GDI-8260-01 Reserve Edition sauna uses 9 total heaters, including 6 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR IR carbon panels and 3 Near IR elements. The heating system is paired with an oversize interior chromotherapy color lighting system and a red light therapy feature, giving users multiple comfort-focused features in one indoor sauna cabin. The sauna also includes 5 Himalayan Salt Bars, with salt features positioned as part of the interior experience and visual design. The listed operating range is 118°F to 132°F, with the sauna able to heat up to 140°F.

Designed for daily usability, the cabin includes an interior LED control panel, Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection, and built-in speakers. These features support simple session control and audio playback without adding separate components inside the sauna. The bronze privacy tempered glass helps create a more enclosed feel while maintaining visibility and light, and the black finish door handle with interior towel bar adds functional detail to the entry area. Exterior accent lighting adds a finished look for indoor placement.

Construction is centered on Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock Wood, a material commonly selected for infrared sauna cabins because it supports a clean interior look and stable panel construction. The sauna has a verified assembled sauna weight of 640 lbs. and a shipping weight of 775 lbs., shipping in 5 boxes. The design is specified for indoor use only, and the electrical service requires dual 120v/15 AMP non-GFCI service with dedicated electrical planning recommended.

Golden Designs focuses on residential sauna products with practical cabin layouts, infrared heating systems, and wellness-oriented features such as chromotherapy, audio, and Canadian Hemlock construction. The GDI-8260-01 is suited for buyers who want a larger indoor infrared sauna with full spectrum heat, privacy glass, salt bar styling, integrated lighting, and verified 6-person seating capacity without moving into an outdoor or commercial sauna format.
